---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---

```{python}
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

@fig-budget-revenue compares production budgets with worldwide box-office revenues. Each point represents one film, and both amounts are measured in millions of US dollars.

```{python}
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Production budgets and worldwide revenues of films in the dataset."
#| echo: true

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Production budget (millions of US dollars)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
